bullets.text: Writing Java to tune upper/lower bounds on EC2 capacity reserved for Amazon Redshift operations like patching, backtesting policies to balance availability against cost
Rebuilt a legacy test-data workflow builder in React/TypeScript + Electron, adding a React-Flow editor and Jest-tested validation; 90% of 30+ surveyed developers preferred it to the old tool
Precomputed a tree-style search index over popular workflows from a 270K+ row PostgreSQL table (Python/SQLAlchemy, Redis cache) to minimize DB queries under access limits
Cut LLM workflow generation time 65% to under 15s by decomposing a Claude skill into sub-skills backed by Python search/validation tools, guided by CloudWatch + OpenSearch latency logs
Shipped a space-research tool used by Amazon Leo's public-policy team, now maintained by Leo engineers; deployed on AWS Fargate (Docker) via GitHub Actions and CDK (TypeScript)
Reduced end-to-end latency 34% for a pipeline routing 6,000+ scraped research documents to inference by moving it onto Kinesis streams feeding Lambda processors
Automated Bedrock source-relevancy model fine-tuning on an EventBridge schedule, with decision gates that skip redundant retraining; added X-Ray tracing and SNS failure alerts
Developing automated training for PhysTwin, a physics-based digital twin, on a PhD-led team targeting ICLR
Engineered a Python pipeline rendering AnyGrasp multi-camera grasp candidates as Open3D overlays for a Qwen3-VL-8B vision-language model, letting researchers isolate scene components
Shortened research-environment setup time 30% with uv dependency pinning and Docker; added psutil time/memory profiling and Pytest suites to find bottlenecks
Co-founded a 110+ member campus product studio that has shipped 5 live products
Wrote Prisma SQL queries and Redis query caching to reduce DB load and latency for Tortuga, a class scheduler that drew 20,000+ visits in its first 30 days
Building a RAG meal-suggestion feature for the official UMD app (GPT-4o mini, ChromaDB + SentenceBERT search); 93% of generated meals rated satisfactory by internal testers
Implemented a C++ order-book simulator replaying historical IEX data, with a contract-based plug-in interface so alternative approaches swap in under the same correctness checks
Designed paginated hash-based order-book storage with an in-memory LFU cache for hot tickers, validating replayed books for drift against IEX historical book data
Benchmarked a time-based adaptive LSM store against a B+ tree for simulation logs, measuring throughput and latency via rdtscp and hardware utilization via Linux perf counters
